units.source_text: 当然，对他来说，不可能浪漫到梦想纯粹性关系的地步。

en.t: Of course, for him, it was impossible to be so romantic as to dream of a purely sexual relationship.

units.source_text: 恐怕只有面对死亡，露出敌意的时候才需要这种东西……

en.t: Perhaps such a thing was needed only when facing death and showing hostility...

units.source_text: 开始枯萎的细竹，赶紧结果……

en.t: The slender bamboo, beginning to wither, hurried to bear fruit...

units.source_text: 饥饿的老鼠，一边移动，一边血肉模糊地反复性交……

en.t: Hungry rats, moving as they went, kept mating in a bloody mass of flesh...

units.source_text: 结核病患者，一个不留全被色情狂附了体……

en.t: The tuberculosis patients, every last one of them, seemed possessed by sexual mania...

units.source_text: 住在塔顶上，往后只能走下台阶的大王或统治者，只顾一味地倾心于后宫的建设……

en.t: Great kings and rulers who lived at the tops of towers and could only descend the stairs from then on devoted themselves solely to building harems...

units.source_text: 等待敌人进攻的士兵们，抓紧每分每秒手淫发泄……

en.t: Soldiers waiting for the enemy attack seized every minute and second to relieve themselves through masturbation...
